user.title: Gecko Setup
user.description: Please provide the IP address of your SPA, or leave it blank to scan your network for available ones.

pick.title: Pick a spa to connect to.

error.no_spa: Couldn't find a spa at that address, please try again.
error.not_ip: Please enter a valid IP address, or leave the field blank to scan.

abort.no_spas: No spas were found on your network. Please ensure you're on the same LAN as the in.touch2 module and check the results against the iOS or Android apps.

data.show_ping: Show the ping sensor (will affect log file size)

add_schedule.name: Add schedule
add_schedule.description: Add a filter cycle or economy schedule to the watercare mode of the targeted Watercare schedules sensor.

type.name: Type
type.description: Filter cycle runs the filtration. Economy sets the times when the spa runs in economy mode.

days.name: Days
days.description: The day the schedule runs, or Weekday, Weekend or Everyday. To run on a range of days, choose the first day here and the last in 'To day'.

to_day.name: To day
to_day.description: The last day of a range of days that starts at 'Days'. Leave empty for a single day, Weekday, Weekend or Everyday.

modify_schedule.name: Modify schedule
modify_schedule.description: Change the days or times of a schedule. Only the fields you fill in are changed.

number.name: Schedule number
number.description: The number of the schedule, as listed in the 'schedules' attribute of the Watercare schedules sensor.
